title: CLAUDE.md (vault-root) runtime body-structure contract
description: Hook-consumable runtime artifact for the vault-root CLAUDE.md body-structure contract. The k8s ValidatingAdmissionPolicy paramKind for the only mandatory vault-root file.
design_source: the vault-root CLAUDE.md template + its locked shape record

_design_notes.consumer: skills/onboarder (author-claude-home.sh renders the {{...}} placeholders at onboard time); documentary otherwise — no write-time guard consumes size_limits or required_sections (the size target + required sections mirror the shipped template + its locked shape record), and post-write-verify.sh explicitly skips CLAUDE.md
_design_notes.evolution_protocol: R-37 atomic lockstep — runtime artifact + template + alignment-lock-record updated in one commit

size_limits.rationale: Hard cap keeps the always-loaded project instructions inside a bounded context budget.

prohibited_rationale: Hooks read governance bundles from disk directly; CLAUDE.md @import is for Claude's reading context only, not hook function. @import of foundation-master / overlay-master / plans-rules pollutes context without serving runtime enforcement.
